newsitem.title: INDONESIA: S. Africa's Mandela arrives in Bali - agency.
newsitem.headline: S. Africa's Mandela arrives in Bali - agency.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela arrived on Indonesia's island resort of Bali on Sunday ahead of a state visit to Jakarta this week, the official Antara news agency reported.
Antara said Mandela arrived early on Sunday in Bali with his entourage and was scheduled to take a rest before flying to Jakarta on Monday for talks with President Suharto.

The South African embassy in Jakarta said last week that the state visit, which will last through July 16, was intended to enhance cooperation between the two countries in trade and investment as well as multilateral cooperation.
It will be Mandela's third visit to Indonesia since his release from prison in 1990, but the first state visit.
